entities.name: Query ELOVL5 protein
observations: 294 aa membrane protein with Pfam ELO domain PF01151.24 spanning residues 28–258.
Full-length homologs include reviewed vertebrate ELOVL5 proteins with 75.6–76.9% identity and E-values 1.79e-177 to 2.21e-179.
Likely catalyzes the first, rate-limiting condensation step of long-chain fatty-acid elongation.
Predicted/annotated as an endoplasmic-reticulum membrane multi-pass protein.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 34.8 kDa and theoretical pI is 9.22.

entities.name: ELOVL5
observations: ELOVL5 is a membrane-bound fatty acid elongase involved in elongation of long-chain and very-long-chain fatty acids.
Reviewed human ELOVL5 annotation describes preference for polyunsaturated acyl-CoA, especially C18:3(n-6), with roles in polyunsaturated fatty-acid biosynthesis and lipid metabolism.
Human ELOVL5 localizes to the endoplasmic-reticulum membrane and interacts with TECR.

entities.name: Very-long-chain fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: The query protein is implicated in the fatty-acid elongation cycle that extends acyl chains by two carbons per cycle.
Associated biological processes include monounsaturated, polyunsaturated, saturated, and very-long-chain fatty-acid biosynthesis, plus sphingolipid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Endoplasmic reticulum membrane
observations: Reviewed ELOVL5 homologs are annotated as endoplasmic-reticulum membrane, multi-pass membrane proteins.
